notes: HELD historical Cataclysm original, not current Retail numeric admission. Source published 2011-11-02 reports milling 5000 Whiptail across three sessions; explicitly reports 3015 Ashen Pigment and 533 Burning Embers. Source describes five herbs per mill; 1000 nominal five-herb equivalents are not independently counted successful casts. Actual successful casts, refunds, net consumption, per-output hit counts, zeros, histogram, exact build, skill and specialization unknown. The author's rounded 3 and 0.5 per mill are approximations, not measured hit rates. Item IDs checked against Wowhead item pages. Comments by other authors and ink conversions are not part of this cohort. Held as reference to prevent historical quantities being pooled as current Retail evidence. Novelty checked by source URL/name against owned status, compact manifest, processing-native-identities and default-branch code search; full assigned-sources index unavailable, so no claim of exhaustive deduplication.
